title: Normalize Vietnamese intent for built-in Skill selection
goal: Ensure common Vietnamese requests select the intended built-in workspace Skill without falling through to answer-only chat when the request clearly names a supported action.
context: SkillRuntime.intentTokens currently tokenizes words but removes only English stop words and does not map Vietnamese action verbs to the English Skill names. A request such as “Hãy tìm kiếm trong workspace” has only one meaningful overlap with “Workspace Search”, so the existing subset/overlap selection rules can return noSelection even though the built-in Skill is in scope.
forbidden_changes: Do not change policy, capability grants, executor mapping, workspace scope, or output verification.
Do not make ambiguous requests select an arbitrary Skill.
Do not modify UI, provider, storage, terminal, or unrelated composition code.
acceptance_criteria: Vietnamese search/read/create requests normalize to action tokens that match the exact built-in Skill names.
English Skill selection behavior remains unchanged.
Ambiguous or unsupported requests continue to return noSelection.
Regression tests cover Vietnamese search, read-file, and create-file intent selection.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: Keep changes confined to SkillRuntime intent token normalization and focused SkillRuntime tests. If a test becomes ambiguous, improve Vietnamese stop-word/synonym normalization rather than adding broad fallback selection.
